integrity: The accompanying self-contained program enumerates all 1920 signed Weyl-group actions, verifies all 18 table rows and the two explicit blowup examples. Mathematical proof relies on stated standard geometric facts, not finite tests alone.
scientific_limitations: Signed Weyl-type formulas are conditional on realizing the type over the ground field. Standard degree-four del Pezzo line geometry and the Weil-Lefschetz trace theorem are mathematical inputs. The complete equivariant table might be implicit in older finite-geometry literature; earlier split-case coverage is acknowledged. No claims regarding rationality, Brauer groups, or independent external validation.
title: Rational points outside the sixteen lines of a quartic del Pezzo surface: all Frobenius types
